chunks: And We have certainly created man from dried clay from black mud shaped into form.

key_terms.حَمَإٍ: Black mud or mud mixed with water
key_terms.صَلْصَالٍ: Dried clay that makes a sound when struck
key_terms.مَسْنُونٍ: Shaped or formed into a specific shape

ai.seo_question: What is the material from which humans were created according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of humanity, where the physical body (jism) is formed from 'sajin' (dried clay) and 'masnun' (black mud shaped by a mold), reflecting the divine order in creation. This material humility serves as a reminder of human dependence on God, a concept central to the Shia understanding of resurrection (ma'ad) and the eventual return of the soul to its Creator.
